name: Entangling Cover
body:
Discipline: Metacreativity; Level: Marksman 2

MANIFESTING

Display: material, Olfactory
Manifesting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: special; see text
Target: 1 creature
Duration: 1 rnd./lvl.
Saving Throw: Reflex negates; Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 3

DESCRIPTION

After manifesting this power, the next creature this round you successfully stagger with your cover fire class ability is also entangled for the duration of the power. If you do not have the cover fire class feature, this power does nothing.
